# Python Service Starter — Route Map

This repository is a Python FastAPI service. Use this map to find your way around.

## Conventions and rules

- /CLAUDE.md            — Project memory, conventions, restrictions
- /AGENTS.md            — Cross-vendor agent guidance (mirrors CLAUDE.md)
- /SECURITY.md          — Security policy, AI tooling disclosure

## Source

- /src/starter/         — Service package
- /src/starter/shared.py — Leaf module: pure utilities, no I/O
- /src/starter/api/     — FastAPI adapter and handlers

## Tests

- /tests/               — pytest test suite, mirrors src/ layout

## Build and verify

- /pyproject.toml       — Deps, tool config (ruff/mypy/black/pytest)
- /Makefile             — Verify orchestration
- /scripts/verify.sh    — Wrapper for CI
- /.python-version      — Python version pin

## Harness (Claude Code)

- /.claude/settings.json — Hooks wiring
- /.claude/skills/       — Reusable skill playbooks (Python-flavored)
- /.claude/agents/       — Subagent roster (planner, reviewer, test-writer)
- /.claude/hooks/        — Bash firewall, protected paths, post-edit format

## CI and PR

- /.github/workflows/verify.yml      — CI pipeline
- /.github/pull_request_template.md  — PR template with AI authorship tags
- /.github/CODEOWNERS                — Review routing
